title: Agent crash mid-backup: the process is killed; Windows brings it back; no ghost run; the next backup restores identical

steps.step: The backup is running (server live view)
Kill the service process (as a crash)
steps.expected: killed WHILE the run is live (its job id read from the server just before)

steps.step: Windows restarts the service by itself (failure actions)
steps.expected: Running with a new process within 3 minutes

steps.step: No ghost: the killed run is not "running" any more
steps.expected: not in the live view; THIS run (its job id) recorded as interrupted
the server records a new run: ok; the window shows the result
steps.actual: ERROR: Cannot index into a null array. @ line 97

steps.step: Restore after the crash - the source folder is deleted
steps.expected: no source folder (moved out of the product's reach until the check is done)
steps.actual: C:\OnlineBackup-QA\Data (kept by the robot in C:\obqa\source-aside-3)

steps.step: Restore after the crash - Restore page
steps.expected: the backup, the latest point, the files, the folder
steps.actual: ITSguard Server Online | OK | Wrong key: open the screen from the desktop shortcut. | No connection to the backup server right now: Wrong key: open the screen from the desktop shortcut. | Restore | Backup | QA files | Restore point (date) | Files (none selected = everything) | Filter by file or folder name | Restore to folder | C:\Users\runneradmin\Desktop\Restore | … | Replace existing files | Restore | Backup status | Restore | New backup | Security | Help | Version —  ·  Check for updates | English | Powered by ITSguard Server Online

steps.expected: 113 files identical, nothing missing or extra
